name: caspule-nfsim-multi-scale-coupling
title: CASPULE-NFSim Multiscale Coupling
description: Two studies probe the CASPULE + NFSim composite at different levels of spatial complexity: dimerization (simple pair formation) and polymer fractionation (size-selective harvesting of clusters up to 4 bonds per atom). Both use the same three-component wiring: CASPULE (MD) → ObservableDetector (spatial→non-spatial bridge) → NFSim (rule-based kinetics).
question: Can bond-aware spatial MD (CASPULE) be tightly coupled to non-spatial rule-based kinetics (NFSim) via an observable detector, and does this coupling produce qualitatively different dynamics than running each simulator independently?
hypothesis: The ObservableDetector bridge enables bidirectional information flow: spatial cluster structure drives NFSim species pools, and NFSim reaction outcomes (atom removal) feed back into CASPULE. This coupling should produce emergent dynamics — e.g. depleted monomer pools that slow bond formation, and NFSim steady-states that reflect the spatial cluster-size distribution — that neither simulator can reproduce alone.

executive.what_is_this: This workspace demonstrates a process-bigraph composite that couples CASPULE (bond-aware LAMMPS MD) to NFSim (BioNetGen rule-based kinetics) through a spatial observable detector. CASPULE evolves atoms and bond clusters; the detector identifies spatial patterns (dimers, trimers, polymers), optionally removes matched atoms from CASPULE, and injects them as molecule counts into NFSim's non-spatial pool. NFSim then evolves downstream kinetics. The composite provides a reusable scaffold for multiscale spatial-to-non-spatial coupling experiments.
executive.verdict: Pending — CASPULE requires OpenMPI on the build host.
executive.verdict_detail: Composite specs are registered and discoverable in the Composites tab. Simulation runs require CASPULE/LAMMPS with MPI support (libmpi.12.dylib), which was not available on the build host (arm64 macOS without OpenMPI). Studies are scaffolded and ready to run on a compatible host.

scientific_argument.main_claim: A process-bigraph composite can faithfully couple bond-aware spatial MD to rule-based non-spatial kinetics through a declarative observable detector, enabling multiscale simulation of cluster-formation dynamics.
caveats: CASPULE requires LAMMPS with bond/create fix and custom cluster analysis; builds with OpenMPI are needed for the published PyPI wheel.

studies.name: caspule-nfsim-dimer
studies.title: CASPULE-NFSim Dimerization
studies.question: How does spatial bond-formation in a CASPULE LJ monomer gas feed molecule counts into downstream NFSim rule-based kinetics, and what does the coupled temporal trajectory of dimer counts and thermo state look like?

studies.name: caspule-nfsim-polymer
studies.title: CASPULE-NFSim Polymer Fractionation
studies.question: How does size-based fractionation of spatial bond clusters (dimers, trimers, and larger polymers) into distinct NFSim molecule species shape the downstream non-spatial activation and decay kinetics?
